policy_id.description: The policy id. The id must contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), numbers (0-9), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Cannot begin or end with underscore or hyphen. Must consist of between 3 and 50 characters.

worker_config.description: Describes how the autoscaler will operate for primary workers.

min_instances.description: Minimum number of instances for this group. Bounds: [2, maxInstances]. Defaults to 2.
min_instances.security_impact: Medium. A value set too low can cause performance degradation or job failures if the cluster cannot maintain a baseline of available workers.
min_instances.rationale: A minimum number of instances must be enforced to ensure a baseline level of performance and availability for workloads.

max_instances.description: Maximum number of instances for this group.
max_instances.security_impact: High. An excessively high value can lead to massive cost overruns if a job triggers extensive scaling. This is a form of 'Denial of Wallet' attack.
max_instances.rationale: A reasonable upper bound must be enforced on all scaling policies to control costs and prevent financial abuse.
